## [GitHub Releases · Redis: 8.6.0](https://github.com/redis/redis/releases/tag/8.6.0)
*GitHub Releases · Redis* | 10/02/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: model_release, evaluation, open_source

> This is the General Availability release of Redis 8.6 in Redis Open Source. ### Major changes compared to 8.4 - Substantial performance improvements - Substantial memory reduction for hashes (hashtable-encoded) and sorted sets (skiplist-encoded) - Streams: `XADD` idempotency (at-most-once guarantee) with new `IDMPAUTO` and `IDMP` arguments - New eviction policies - least recently modified: `volatile-lrm` and `allkeys-lrm` - Hot keys detection and reporting; new command: `HOTKEYS` - TLS certificate-based automatic client authentication - Time series: support NaN values; new aggregators: `COUNTNAN` and `COUNTALL` For more details, see the [8.6 release](https://redis.io/blog/announcing-redis-86-performance-improvements-streams/) blog post. ### Binary distributions - Alpine and Debian Docker images - https://hub.docker.com/_/redis - Install using snap - see https://github.com/redis/redis-snap - Install using brew - see https://github.com/redis/homebrew-redis - Install using RPM - see https
